correctness.rationale: The PBH eigenvector criterion and exact P_n x P_2 tensor eigenbasis reduce the rank to distinct active spectral atoms. A rational collision is necessarily an integer gap; an elementary algebraic-integer norm argument classifies all allowable gaps as 2 or 3 and their exact index pairs. Path zeros are counted by gcd(n,2s-1), and every cross-branch collision is checked for potential double-counting. The analytic argument treats all n and all rational rung weights >=1. A standalone verifier matched 504 finite-field Krylov-rank computations; finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
